trace_adequacy.selection_rule: all 100 cases plus every one of 13 membership-change cases
trace_adequacy.target_boundary: Silver and answers are posthoc only; no panel-conditioned online selector

intervention_execution.claim: The scalar residual is active and changes 13 Top-5 sets.

intended_intermediate.claim: Reliable support discrimination is not established; helpful and harmful swaps share span sharpness changes.

observable_output.claim: Positive retention is 204 versus 203; direct 138 versus 138; no reliable gain.

task_utility.claim: No downstream utility or generalization conclusion is measured.

primary_explanation.statement: Four scalar signals may discard the relation-support semantics needed to distinguish topical fragments from evidence; this is a hypothesis.

alternative_explanations.statement: Noisy containment supervision or insufficient convergence may explain the same screen; prior training compact records remain missing.

discriminating_measurement.measurement: Train scalar quantum and semantic quantum heads on identical cases/order/loss; add same-budget classical semantic control and complete trace replay.
discriminating_measurement.primary_outcome: Semantic head improves useful/direct evidence retention relative to both scalar and baseline.
discriminating_measurement.alternative_outcome: No semantic improvement, or classical control matches/exceeds it; inspect target quality and training witnesses before attributing quantum advantage.

forbidden_rescue_variants: Tune scalar span coefficients on the exposed 100-case panel
Increase circuit depth solely to rescue this panel
Treat arbitrary nonpositive reference fillers as gold evidence

positive_carryovers.mechanism: Raw relevance plus bounded zero-initialized residual avoids unconditional score replacement.
positive_carryovers.transport_constraint: Frozen Reader baseline is exact at initialization; scope stays Top-50 to Top-5.

selected_candidate.title: Question-conditioned quantum semantic residual
selected_candidate.causal_difference: A trained classical bottleneck projects joint Reader CLS/question/passage/interaction representations into the quantum head instead of four output statistics.
selected_candidate.discriminating_measurement: Semantic versus scalar quantum paired useful/direct retention, per-candidate encoding/readout/gate, matched classical control and value replay
selected_candidate.success_gate: Primary positive evidence gain with paired CI lower above zero and no direct-count reduction; quantum attribution evaluated separately.
selected_candidate.kill_condition: Fatal trace/null/leakage failure stops run; ordinary short-screen null is inconclusive and not promoted.
selected_candidate.authorization_boundary: User authorized implementation and collaborator exploratory screen; no formal or full-data run, no local task/corpus download, no novelty or quantum advantage claim.

limitations: Exploratory implementation only; formal dataset/baseline qualification and novelty audit pending.
The previous short-screen training records have not been recovered.
The 100-case panel is exposed development evidence and requires independent future confirmation.
